releasePlan.notes: Flag enable-player-login already existed (created dark in an earlier run tagged pr-34; v1 unreleased, off in production+test). create_flag was an idempotent no-op; client-side availability enabled. PR #35 code lives under v1. Flag is evaluated once in init() after LD init and before identify(). Control = original start screen + anonymous context. Known v1 caveat: the R key / touch restart button can bypass the login (restartGame hides loginOverlay).
